g.title: DESIGN ASSURANCE / CONTRACTS, NOT REQUEST TRAFFIC
POO Governance / Cedar Shared model / exact projection
Runtime source admission Exact operation / current facts
Discovery and reconciliation Scoped endpoints / routes
Workload identity integration Authenticated / scoped facts
Go or Rust ingress Exact actor / target / payload
Rust effect coordinator One fenced state owner
Final egress broker Bound bytes / peer / credential
Authority / Cedar evaluation Allow / error-free required checks
Coordination ledger History / budget / unique claims
Code as Policy Admitted artifact closure
No ambient authority Explicit role and audience
Quint / concurrent state model Consume / commit / claim / send / recovery
Lean / semantic preservation Cedar-POO meaning / projection / invariants

POO defines governed effects across requests; the runtime preserves one-use state, history and budget. Quint / Lean links constrain the design. Each send needs current admission, a typed claim and the final broker gate.
